caption: Figure 1: (a) Physical layout of a datacenter (in elevation view) comparing the deployment footprint of SmartSwitch (SS) and Sirius. (b) Logical diagram of the architecture of DPU-centric appliance (Sirius) and SONiC DASH SmartSwitch.

files.source.svg: SVG extracted from the published PDF (PyMuPDF; text kept as <text>, fonts embedded)
files.print.png: the figure as extracted from the published PDF, at print size
files.semantics.json: full semantic record for this figure

templates.why_chosen: Panel (a) uses a literal red X on Sirius's placement versus a green check on SmartSwitch's, and panel (b) contrasts Sirius's multi-hop topology against the SmartSwitch's layered stack, all in one dense 32-component double-column figure.
templates.what_to_learn: Use a literal red X for a rejected placement and a green check for the accepted one to make a physical-fit argument at a glance; if a second panel packs two different diagrams together, split them into their own lettered sub-panels rather than one shared label, since merging them (as here) hides the second diagram.
